title: Closed Profile
description: A closed profile drawn on a view. Its points carry the view's viewId and are in its coordinates, which its viewToPaperMatrix maps to the sheet: model meters, or sheet units from the view's center on a broken view. z is 0. A point without a viewId is read in sheet coordinates.

profileType.description: Shape of the profile, or SketchEntities to build it from sketch entities on the sheet.

center.description: Center of the circle, in the view's coordinates. A reference to a point of the view keeps the center on that point when the view changes.

radius.description: Radius of the circle, in the view's units.

center.description: Center of the rectangle, in the view's coordinates. The rectangle is aligned with the view's axes.

width.description: Width of the rectangle along the view's X axis, in the view's units.

height.description: Height of the rectangle along the view's Y axis, in the view's units.

vertices.description: Corners of the polygon, or fit points of the closed spline, in order, in the view's coordinates. The profile closes back to the first one and must not intersect itself.

logicalIds.description: Logical ids of sketch entities on the sheet that form one closed profile, as the command takes a preselected profile: the profile is built from them and the entities are erased. Accepted on create and edit only; export reports the profile as one of the other types, so three lines forming a triangle come back as a Polygon of three vertices. Which entities are accepted depends on where the profile is used.
